findings.body: These cells are rendered only by the statement-bound `DrillPanel`; its selection still requires a `MisStatementResolvedResponse` and it reads through the statement drill hook. The general Ask answer therefore cannot display document number, cost centre, or account name yet. The plan assigns that integration to the later `GL-DRILL-PANEL` task, so this is deferred work rather than a blocking gap in this prerequisite task.
findings.title: Later: show the three transaction fields in Ask → GL-DRILL-PANEL
